title: Wafa jiska padhe kalma
body:
Wafa jiska padhe kalma
Wafa Jis Ka Parhe Kalma Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jise Sajdain Kare Sajda Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
Who Pyaasa Pyaas Ne Jis Ki Kiya Sairaab Darya Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Jis Ki Pyaas Bhi Darya Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
Lagaye Jo Bagair-e-Taig Ki Anbaar Laashoon Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Hai Paikar shuja’at Ka Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
Jo Hai Shabbir Ki Quwat Ali Ko Naaz Hai Jis Per
<<DIVIDER>>
Jisse Zehra Kahe Beta Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
Jo Tha Shabbir Ka Khadim Mager Sab Sahebaan-e-Dil
<<DIVIDER>>
Usse Aaqa Usse Maula Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
Wafa Jis Ka Parhe Kalma Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jise Sajdain Kare Sajda Usse Abbas Kehte Hain
author: Mir Hassan Mir
